question: Which goddess protects the right ear through the three-syllable essence?
premises: The seed syllable śrīṃ is invoked.
Protection is requested for the right ear.
Maheśvarī is identified as having a three-syllable essence.
inference: Maheśvarī, whose essence is three syllables, is invoked with śrīṃ to protect the right ear.
plain_english: May śrīṃ protect my right ear; may Maheśvarī, whose essence is three syllables, protect it.
